a.xlink:title: True if address is listed in the comma-separated trustedSources (security/trusted_sources).
True when the address is in security/trusted_sources and therefore exempt from per-address limits.
Overload for an address in string form; an unparsable string never matches.
True if the (address, username) pair is already locked out of logging in.
Record a failed login attempt for the (address, username) pair; returns true if now locked out.
